title: Code for "Escaping AB caging via Floquet engineering: drive-induced long-range interference in an all-band-flat model"
description:
Python code to reproduce all figures of A. Ahmed, M. Benito and B. Pérez-González, "Escaping AB caging via Floquet engineering: drive-induced long-range interference in an all-band-flat model", arXiv:2511.20255.

The model is a π-flux diamond (rhombic) chain whose on-site energies are driven by a square wave. The code computes its exact Floquet spectrum and stroboscopic dynamics, the high-frequency effective Hamiltonian and its mapping to a decorated Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain, Zak phases, and the dynamics and entanglement of two interacting fermions.

Each figure has a Jupyter notebook that computes its data, and a separate notebook makes all the figures. The numerical data is not included; it is generated by running the notebooks. Dependencies are pinned with uv (Python 3.13). README.md explains how to install and run the code and maps each figure to its notebook, data file and figure file.
